identity.description: Fabric API's transactional transfer abstraction (Storage, StorageView, ItemVariant/FluidVariant, ItemStorage/FluidStorage/EnergyStorage lookups) used for item, fluid, and energy movement between Fabric mods.

constraints: Requires attribution: Apache-2.0 requires retaining the copyright/license notice and a NOTICE file where applicable

requiredState: a Storage<T> exposed per block face via BlockApiLookup (ItemStorage.SIDED / FluidStorage.SIDED)
StorageView<T> exposing resource identity (ItemVariant/FluidVariant) and amount per slot/tank
an open Transaction wrapping every insert/extract call so multiple operations commit or roll back atomically
inputSemantics: insert(resource, maxAmount, transaction) returns the amount actually accepted
nested/child transactions allow speculative simulation via transaction.openNested() then abort() instead of commit()
outputSemantics: extract(resource, maxAmount, transaction) returns the amount actually removed
StorageView iteration exposes current per-slot resource and amount without mutating state

implementationPattern: Transaction-scoped Storage<T> lookups resolved per block and side through BlockApiLookup; every insert/extract takes an open Transaction so callers can simulate by opening a nested transaction and aborting it instead of committing, giving atomic multi-step operations across item, fluid, and (via companion Team Reborn Energy API) energy resources
limitations: Energy transfer is not part of fabric-transfer-api-v1 itself; it is commonly layered on via the separate community Team Reborn Energy API using the same transaction pattern
Storage<T> providers must be registered per block via BlockApiLookup; there is no single universal capability registry like Forge's
bedrockFeasibilityHint: The transaction-scoped simulate/commit pattern is the key semantic a Bedrock adapter must preserve; Hydraulic's own MultiResourceTransaction substrate already mirrors this open/commit/rollback shape for item, fluid, and energy operations

strongIndicators: Fabric API is a first-party, extensively used Fabric library (3.2k stars, 1,198 releases, 216 contributors)
Transfer API module is a well-defined, isolated Gradle module (fabric-transfer-api-v1) with a clear transaction-based contract
weakIndicators: Energy transfer semantics are documented via the companion community Energy API rather than fabric-transfer-api-v1 itself
gaps: This entry documents the public interface contract only; it does not inspect any specific mod's implementation

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-09-11 against the public repository file listing (fabric-transfer-api-v1 module) and its Apache-2.0 license badge/LICENSE file.
No Fabric API source code was copied into Hydraulic; only the documented public transaction/storage contract was recorded.
